b992e1502b3303de.en: Archive the appeal as a repeat without considering the new information.
b992e1502b3303de.zh: 不审理新信息，直接将诉求作为重复件归档。

7f973d2217dab2e4.en: Ask the citizen to test the voltage before accepting the materials.
7f973d2217dab2e4.zh: 要求公民先测电压，再受理材料。

e7e046b130173deb.en: Refer the new information for consideration within the relevant remit and promptly alert the duty officer to the possible danger.
e7e046b130173deb.zh: 将新信息按权限交付审理，并立即向值班人员报告可能存在的危险。

607663dccb7f73d1.en: You answered before. But this has changed
607663dccb7f73d1.zh: 您曾答复过，但情况有了变化

a313af1660fde640.en: Article 11 requires a combination of conditions; the number of earlier responses does not replace checking them.
a313af1660fde640.zh: 第11条要求同时满足一组条件；此前答复次数不能替代条件核查。

a80ffbdc3c877946.en: Agree and remove the new photograph.
a80ffbdc3c877946.zh: 认同该说法并删除新照片。

4204cfc0154e2329.en: Personally guarantee repair of the damage as a trainee.
4204cfc0154e2329.zh: 以实习生个人名义保证修复损坏。

9626fd78e9f45275.en: Check the new circumstances and authority to decide.
9626fd78e9f45275.zh: 核查新情况及决定权限。

e24ceebe7fb2dd74.en: Assistant: “Two earlier responses automatically remove the duty to assess the new photograph.”
e24ceebe7fb2dd74.zh: 助手：“此前答复过两次，就自动无需评估新照片。”

9f38849cb9e4e234.en: A permissible route when the right to end correspondence is not exercised.
9f38849cb9e4e234.zh: 不行使终止往来权利时可采用的路径。

08178c44276c3cac.zh: 准备再次作出实质性答复

10e03f777d0370be.en: Independently end correspondence on the manager’s behalf
10e03f777d0370be.zh: 自行代表负责人终止往来

cff733b55cb421c0.en: Block all new appeals from this citizen
cff733b55cb421c0.zh: 阻止该公民提出任何新诉求

ab0313e4dfc64de9.en: Do not rely solely on the counter.

74743ba0cc664ee9.en: Check the issue, recipient, earlier responses’ substance and absence of new information
74743ba0cc664ee9.zh: 核查事项、收件人、此前答复内容以及是否没有新信息

3d29135935096271.en: For the specific issue, not a ban on all future appeals.
3d29135935096271.zh: 仅针对具体问题，并非禁止所有未来诉求。

8f5fc2afad18f364.en: Prepare a notice in case a decision to end correspondence is made
8f5fc2afad18f364.zh: 为可能作出的终止往来决定准备通知

dace86a7a49b429a.en: A correspondence decision does not cancel recording of receipt.
dace86a7a49b429a.zh: 关于往来的决定并不取消收件登记。

a8d3c368d083d566.en: Preserve the ability to raise other issues and new circumstances
a8d3c368d083d566.zh: 保留提出其他问题及新情况的途径

a6582b7dffa484ef.en: Do not announce that the decision has already been made.
a6582b7dffa484ef.zh: 不要宣布决定已经作出。

af1e1d7806eaa8b9.en: Prepare materials for the authorised decision-maker
af1e1d7806eaa8b9.zh: 为有权决定的人员准备材料

e3461ac8f3d604d6.en: Record the actual decision and how it was communicated
e3461ac8f3d604d6.zh: 记录实际作出的决定及告知情况

4cd85aac365d15ca.en: The same authority has repeatedly given written substantive responses to this exact issue. Comparison confirms no new arguments or circumstances. No decision to end correspondence exists yet. An authorised manager may consider that option, but the law does not require it. The trainee only prepares materials. The calendar task asks for the deadline to register the new letter, not an invented special deadline for a termination notice.
4cd85aac365d15ca.zh: 同一机关已多次就此具体问题作出书面实质性答复。比对确认没有新理由或新情况。尚无终止往来的决定。有权负责人可以考虑该选项，但法律并不强制如此。实习生仅准备材料。日历任务要求计算新信函的登记期限，而非虚构的终止通知特别期限。

39ca85bbe2c094d8.en: The new letter has arrived but is not yet registered. Calculate the registration deadline. Further correspondence is decided separately.
39ca85bbe2c094d8.zh: 新信函已收到但尚未登记。请计算登记期限。是否继续往来另行决定。

f1a212ee1d5687c7.en: Banning all subsequent appeals exceeds the scope of a decision on a specific issue.
f1a212ee1d5687c7.zh: 禁止所有后续诉求超出了具体问题决定的范围。

6e8d53921e70d38a.en: The label reflects the record count. It does not itself check whether the issue matches, what the responses say or whether new material exists.
6e8d53921e70d38a.zh: 标签反映记录数量，本身不会核查事项是否相同、答复内容或是否存在新材料。

3d036c3ee19838b3.en: The same question and attachments were sent again to authority A. Content comparison confirms no new arguments or circumstances. No termination decision exists yet.
3d036c3ee19838b3.zh: 相同问题和附件再次提交机关A。内容比对确认没有新理由或新情况，尚无终止决定。

50a183026df2e94a.en: Authority A twice considered the work arrangements at the site and gave reasoned responses to every argument, with dispatch confirmed. Different departments signed on behalf of the same authority A.
50a183026df2e94a.zh: 机关A两次审理场地作业安排，对全部理由作出有依据的答复，并确认已发送。不同部门均代表同一机关A签署。

7b3fdb11c063d5b1.en: The provision grants a right when all conditions are met, not a duty to terminate automatically.
7b3fdb11c063d5b1.zh: 该规定在全部条件满足时授予一项权利，而非自动终止的义务。

aaf6ffec55358906.en: The law always forbids considering termination, even when every condition is met.
aaf6ffec55358906.zh: 即使全部条件满足，法律也始终禁止考虑终止。

55b804c15c7c12d1.en: A third letter automatically ends all the citizen’s correspondence with the authority.
55b804c15c7c12d1.zh: 第三封信会自动终止该公民与机关的一切往来。

165b92eacacab415.en: The conditions for a possible decision to end correspondence on this issue are confirmed; the decision is optional and is not automatically made by a trainee.
165b92eacacab415.zh: 可能就本问题终止往来的条件已确认；该决定并非强制，也不能由实习生自动作出。

4f14d6e63caae71a.en: How should the authorised official’s power in this case be characterised?
4f14d6e63caae71a.zh: 应如何理解有权人员在本案中的权限？

5e868760e6d2a4e1.en: New facts require their own assessment; the previous case label cannot replace it.
5e868760e6d2a4e1.zh: 新事实需要单独评估，旧案标签不能替代。

cf609d05fcb19484.en: In the next letter, the citizen reports new damage at the same site and attaches fresh material not previously available.
cf609d05fcb19484.zh: 下一封信中，公民报告同一场地的新损坏，并附上此前没有的新材料。

dccf403fe08db700.en: Assess the new circumstance separately; earlier action on the old issue does not block all new materials.
dccf403fe08db700.zh: 单独评估新情况；对旧问题的此前处理并不意味着封锁所有新材料。

5d0607d3b2f991da.en: Delete the new letter unread because of the old history.
5d0607d3b2f991da.zh: 因旧记录存在而不阅读就删除新信。

9a0a377c85323171.en: Require the citizen to waive the right to appeal first.
9a0a377c85323171.zh: 要求公民先放弃提出诉求的权利。

f411942242c7ac90.en: The authorised official may make this decision; the citizen must be notified and the scope must remain limited to the specific issue.
f411942242c7ac90.zh: 有权人员可以作出该决定，但必须通知公民，并限于具体问题的范围。

d7cd644af37d1703.en: Every employee must automatically end all correspondence.
d7cd644af37d1703.zh: 任何员工都必须自动终止一切往来。

5634655f4dfe74e1.en: An information-system marker replaces the authorised official’s decision.
5634655f4dfe74e1.zh: 信息系统标记可以替代有权人员的决定。

ddd52f3f23c72cdd.en: Determine whether ending correspondence is mandatory when the conditions are met.
ddd52f3f23c72cdd.zh: 查明满足条件后是否必须终止往来。

2beced6d49343b6e.en: I sent the old question and the same attachments again. I have read both responses but still disagree. I have no new information now.
2beced6d49343b6e.zh: 我再次提交了原问题和相同附件。我了解两份答复内容，但仍不同意。目前没有新信息。

bdbf35c3923d9bfb.en: Yes, I repeat the same arguments. I have read the responses.
bdbf35c3923d9bfb.zh: 是的，我重复相同理由，也读过答复。

30a8f3273b01d179.en: Earlier substantive responses to the same issue exist.
30a8f3273b01d179.zh: 已存在针对同一问题的此前实质性答复。

6340090d64192300.en: Did the responses address all your current arguments?
6340090d64192300.zh: 此前答复是否涉及你现在提出的全部理由？

37277e40c65c56fe.en: No. I am expressing disagreement with the responses already given.
37277e40c65c56fe.zh: 没有，我只是不同意已有答复。

ed2e27073b07f1aa.en: The scenario provides no new circumstances.

c8e17cdf5a078d1d.en: Is there a new fact or circumstance?
c8e17cdf5a078d1d.zh: 是否有新事实或新情况？

d09a1e931120a24d.en: Yes, the recipient details are the same.

45f7f51867e9be9c.en: Were all appeals sent to the same authority?
45f7f51867e9be9c.zh: 所有诉求是否提交同一机关？

50f02f6ef700ed17.en: Independently block acceptance of every future letter from the citizen.
50f02f6ef700ed17.zh: 自行阻止受理该公民今后的所有信函。

4a64c642e6a2a910.en: Continue consideration and prepare another substantive response; termination is not mandatory.
4a64c642e6a2a910.zh: 继续审理并准备再次实质答复；终止并非强制。

32a4a34200855f6b.en: Prepare materials for the authorised manager to consider possible termination of correspondence on the specific issue.
32a4a34200855f6b.zh: 为有权负责人准备材料，供其考虑是否就具体问题终止往来。

1b61252d4fac5dd7.en: The same question, the same arguments
1b61252d4fac5dd7.zh: 同一个问题，同样的理由

cea0b073bbdc0804.en: Treat termination as the only correct option regardless of authority.
cea0b073bbdc0804.zh: 不考虑权限，将终止视为唯一正确选项。

7e224ba3d6e7e222.en: A right to terminate is not a duty to exercise it; the chosen route is assessed for consistency.
7e224ba3d6e7e222.zh: 有权终止不代表必须行使该权利；应评估所选路径的一致性。

2708389e8328041b.en: Assistant: “If termination is allowed, every other lawful route is a mistake.”
2708389e8328041b.zh: 助手：“既然允许终止，其他任何合法路径都是错误。”

d300027eceb157fe.en: All conditions for possible termination are confirmed
d300027eceb157fe.zh: 可能终止的全部条件已确认

76e2658d5be8481b.en: A power of the authorised official, not an automatic step
76e2658d5be8481b.zh: 这是有权人员的权利，并非自动操作

e791fd8cd7e37c2f.en: Two coherent lawful routes are allowed; the plan is checked against the chosen route.
e791fd8cd7e37c2f.zh: 允许两种协调一致的合法路径；按所选路径核查计划。

4f2262d715c2a854.en: Check who issued the earlier responses and the history of appeals specifically to us
4f2262d715c2a854.zh: 核查此前答复由谁作出，以及向本机关提出诉求的历史

efe094e4e5254f7f.en: Compare the current subject with our established remit
efe094e4e5254f7f.zh: 比对当前事项与本机关既定权限

3862452bcb8c000a.en: Prepare consideration of our own issue using the materials
3862452bcb8c000a.zh: 依据材料准备审理本机关权限内事项

ed3d34516167e072.en: Explain the limits of our authority’s decision without requiring the applicant to renounce earlier letters
ed3d34516167e072.zh: 说明本机关决定的范围，不要求申请人放弃此前信函

63a35f0c3ada13fe.en: Check that the final response actually addresses the present subject
63a35f0c3ada13fe.zh: 核查最终答复是否确实针对当前事项

80e6d2b0787c4407.en: Claim another authority’s responses as our own grounds for ending correspondence
80e6d2b0787c4407.zh: 把其他机关答复算作本机关答复，以此终止往来

0905950dbe2e806a.en: Refuse consideration solely because the applicant contacted several organisations
0905950dbe2e806a.zh: 仅因申请人联系过多个组织就拒绝审理

0e564524412f8efd.en: Checking for new arguments is insufficient: this variant changes who issued the earlier responses. A first appeal to the competent authority cannot be closed based on other authorities’ history.
0e564524412f8efd.zh: 仅核查有无新理由并不足够：本变体改变了此前答复的主体。不能依据其他机关的历史记录，结束首次向有管辖权机关提出的诉求。

3d5cb00490e39f45.en: The training documents confirm responses from two other authorities. This is the applicant’s first appeal to the current competent authority. The issue falls within its remit, so there is no duty to refer it elsewhere again.
3d5cb00490e39f45.zh: 教学文件确认了其他两个机关的答复。申请人首次向当前有管辖权机关提出诉求。问题属于其权限，因此无需再次按管辖权转交。

8a3cc81591787c9b.en: Recipients and subjects of earlier letters
8a3cc81591787c9b.zh: 此前信函的收件人与事项

38e3c4ffb732e3c8.en: The specific subject is within the current authority’s powers. Earlier responses are attached for comparison. A letter on a familiar topic must not automatically be labelled repeated correspondence with this authority.
38e3c4ffb732e3c8.zh: 具体事项属于当前机关权限。此前答复附上供比较。不能把任何熟悉主题的信函都认定为本机关的多次往来。

4bdba9fd785c9633.en: Earlier responses from other authorities do not establish the same-authority condition for ending our own correspondence under Part 5 of Article 11.
4bdba9fd785c9633.zh: 其他机关此前的答复不能证明满足第11条第5款所要求的向同一机关提出诉求的条件，不能据此终止本机关往来。

a57308a65208fd54.en: A response from any authority releases all others from considering issues within their remit.
a57308a65208fd54.zh: 任何机关答复后，其他机关就无需审理自身权限内问题。

812b07e23d8d3e1c.en: All authorities form one reception office, so the author of the earlier response does not matter.
812b07e23d8d3e1c.zh: 所有机关相当于同一接待处，因此此前答复由谁作出不重要。

3e4e2e5c204b94df.en: Training follow-up. While preparing the draft, an old response from our authority is found, but it addresses another problem mentioned in the neighbouring paragraph of the earlier letter.
3e4e2e5c204b94df.zh: 教学后续情境。准备草稿时找到本机关一份旧答复，但它针对的是旧信相邻段落提到的另一个问题。

af5744546423fefd.en: Compare the subjects: our response about a different problem does not prove repeated responses to the current issue.
af5744546423fefd.zh: 比对事项：本机关对其他问题的答复，不能证明已多次答复当前问题。

6f4006d826a575b1.en: End all correspondence: an outgoing reference from our authority has now been found.
6f4006d826a575b1.zh: 已经找到本机关发文编号，终止一切往来。

5540844731949165.en: Delete the old document to avoid examining the differences.
5540844731949165.zh: 删除旧文件，免于区分不同事项。

a6a393b03299139f.en: Do not end our own consideration on the basis of someone else’s correspondence; assess the established issue within our remit.
a6a393b03299139f.zh: 不得依据其他机关的往来终止本机关审理；应评估已明确属于本机关权限的事项。

2dfd668de1204022.en: Two organisations have already replied to me. I came to your authority now because the earlier letters involve different powers. Here they say there will be no new response because correspondence on this topic already exists.
2dfd668de1204022.zh: 已有两个组织答复过我。现在我来贵机关，是因为此前信函涉及的是其他权限。这里却说，这个主题已有往来，不再答复。

fe73c380bbd16bb6.zh: 是其他两个机关，不是贵机关。

2382fdb6c33bbefe.en: Identify who carried out the earlier consideration.
2382fdb6c33bbefe.zh: 需要确定此前审理的主体。

0070ce4d18b65c32.en: The current authority has not had repeated correspondence.
0070ce4d18b65c32.zh: 当前机关此前没有多次往来。

d876813b4ac83150.en: Have you appealed to our authority before?
d876813b4ac83150.zh: 以前是否向本机关提出过诉求？

0c5e8b7c910754a1.en: An action specifically within your authority’s powers, as confirmed by the competence card.
0c5e8b7c910754a1.zh: 涉及专属于贵机关权限的行动，权限卡已确认。

4fe885c146c3dbdc.en: Our authority must assess its own subject.
4fe885c146c3dbdc.zh: 本机关必须评估自身权限内事项。

d60096d246bbeaeb.en: What is the current issue about?

f104fbcefbc0c58a.en: Yes, they show what has already been explained and what remains unresolved.
f104fbcefbc0c58a.zh: 附上了，有助于了解已说明什么、还剩哪些问题。

f7cff1c87d1671fa.en: They may be used as materials without treating others’ correspondence as our own.
f7cff1c87d1671fa.zh: 可以把它们作为材料使用，但不能将其他机关往来算作本机关的。

244d585d7d22ff29.en: Consider the issue within our own remit, using earlier responses as materials rather than automatic grounds for termination.
244d585d7d22ff29.zh: 在本机关权限内审理问题，将此前答复作为材料，而非自动终止依据。

252867491e2e16d5.en: Close the first appeal to our authority because of repeated correspondence with others.
252867491e2e16d5.zh: 因与其他机关多次往来，结束首次提交本机关的诉求。

07164abde31159f2.en: Refer back an issue that falls within our established powers.
07164abde31159f2.zh: 把明确属于本机关权限的问题转回其他机关。

8219233a19f16f37.en: There were responses, but from another authority
8219233a19f16f37.zh: 有过答复，但来自其他机关

66d586930f22c4bd.en: Check the authority, issue, earlier responses’ contents, repetition and new arguments, not just one detail.
66d586930f22c4bd.zh: 应核查机关、事项、此前答复内容、重复性及新理由，而非只看一项信息。

320bcbba969e75d1.en: All that matters is any number in the database.
320bcbba969e75d1.zh: 只要数据库里有任何编号就行。

424d062934ceb1f4.en: Assistant: “One outgoing reference number found proves every condition for ending correspondence.”
424d062934ceb1f4.zh: 助手：“找到一个发文编号，就证明终止往来的全部条件已满足。”

7e3a8f4a3ededb9c.en: Compare the contents of all earlier messages
7e3a8f4a3ededb9c.zh: 比较所有此前消息的内容

ab8b8db3448b959a.en: Establish whether the issue was considered substantively
ab8b8db3448b959a.zh: 查明是否对事项作过实质性审理

2c3db448156a6b72.en: Prepare proper consideration and assessment of the unfinished earlier case
2c3db448156a6b72.zh: 准备适当审理，并评估此前未办结的案件

df545d39115f6ea1.en: Explain which issues will be considered without requiring the applicant to invent new arguments
df545d39115f6ea1.zh: 说明将审理哪些问题，不要求申请人编造新理由

7698311e62773bd2.en: Check completeness of the next response and the status of the original obligations
7698311e62773bd2.zh: 核查后续答复完整性及原有义务的履行状态

175da7632f9baa1d.en: Treat a registration notice as the final substantive response
175da7632f9baa1d.zh: 将登记通知视为最终实质性答复

edd2c1063c9122c2.en: Start a new period as though the earlier unfinished appeal never existed
edd2c1063c9122c2.zh: 像此前未办结诉求不存在一样，重新起算期限

5493bfed6cdb4463.en: In the no-new-arguments variant, earlier responses genuinely address the issue; here they are only notices, so the letter count does not provide the same grounds.
5493bfed6cdb4463.zh: 在没有新理由的变体中，此前答复确实回应了实质问题；本案却只有通知，因此信函数量不能提供同样的依据。

f5ab51fc682c212e.en: The training collection contains registration confirmation, a referral notice and a current-status message. None addresses the substantive question. The current authority is competent; no decision on the issue has been made.
f5ab51fc682c212e.zh: 教学材料包括登记确认、转交通知及当前状态消息，均未实质回应所提问题。当前机关有管辖权，但尚未就问题作出决定。

a0d3e19aa7276551.en: The applicant repeats the same question and requests an answer. The calendar exercise calculates the deadline for the newly registered appeal. This does not erase obligations or possible missed deadlines on the earlier material.
a0d3e19aa7276551.zh: 申请人重复同一问题并要求答复。日历练习计算新登记诉求的期限。这不会消除此前材料的办理义务或可能存在的逾期问题。

28dc6316a6b2dd04.en: Earlier notices do not establish repeated written substantive responses; grounds for ending correspondence on this basis have not been established.
28dc6316a6b2dd04.zh: 此前通知不能证明已多次作出书面实质性答复，因此未确立据此终止往来的依据。

12a0c1cec0566922.en: Three outgoing reference numbers automatically entitle the authority to end correspondence.
12a0c1cec0566922.zh: 三个发文编号自动赋予机关终止往来的权利。

0723cae971cb29bf.en: The applicant must provide a new fact, otherwise any letter is deleted.
0723cae971cb29bf.zh: 申请人必须提供新事实，否则任何信函都予删除。

179eb95682ee54c6.en: Training follow-up. The case officer prepared a response, but it again gives only the registration number and the date of transfer to their department.
179eb95682ee54c6.zh: 教学后续情境。经办人员准备了答复，但其中再次只写登记编号和转入本部门的日期。

602f6608cb0e4c9a.en: Verify the absence of an answer to the question and return the draft for substantive consideration within the relevant remit.
602f6608cb0e4c9a.zh: 核实未答复所提问题后，将草稿退回，在权限内作实质性审理。

26b7a3bcae4fc8c1.en: Close the case: there are now four outgoing letters.
26b7a3bcae4fc8c1.zh: 结案：现在已有四封发出信函。

b7f9beb8d9b0ec06.en: Accuse the applicant of repetition without reading the draft.
b7f9beb8d9b0ec06.zh: 不读草稿，就指责申请人重复提出。

9d828fe1e662cd1a.en: Continue proper consideration: the condition of repeated written substantive responses is not confirmed.
9d828fe1e662cd1a.zh: 继续适当审理：尚未确认已多次作出书面实质性答复这一条件。

d67d9462fa151c97.en: Find the article on handling specific types of appeals and match the relevant part to the case circumstances.
d67d9462fa151c97.zh: 查找关于特定诉求办理程序的条款，并将相关款项与案情比对。

8ea22788293fb2bb.en: They say my question has been answered three times. But the first letter only gives an incoming number, the second says where it was forwarded, and the third says it is still under review. Where is the answer to the actual question?
8ea22788293fb2bb.zh: 他们说已经三次答复我的问题。但第一封只有收文编号，第二封说转给了哪里，第三封说仍在审理。对问题本身的答复在哪里？

dfc4c9f663b4864d.en: Registration is not resolution of the issue.
dfc4c9f663b4864d.zh: 登记并不等于问题解决。

03fe1ef78f2db2e4.en: What is in the first letter?

8cbb18b228065db7.en: The material was referred to the competent authority; there are no conclusions about the problem.
8cbb18b228065db7.zh: 材料已按管辖权转交，但没有关于问题的结论。

f34ce0c0c4a9cf9b.en: Referral does not replace a substantive response.
f34ce0c0c4a9cf9b.zh: 转交不能代替实质性答复。

546f0d36b61e6bfa.en: What does the second letter say?

2cdd764b44efbe6f.en: An interim status without assessment of the circumstances.
2cdd764b44efbe6f.zh: 只是中间状态，没有评估具体情况。

075db358e729de3c.en: The number of messages is not the number of substantive responses.
075db358e729de3c.zh: 消息数量不等于实质性答复数量。

e0a53bb8c018a512.en: What is in the third letter?

353b8958b1f30633.en: Our authority received the material and is authorised to consider the issue. It need not be sent to another recipient again.
353b8958b1f30633.zh: 本机关已收到材料，并有权审理该问题，无需再次转给其他收件人。

69603e9798685d2b.en: The current authority’s competence is established.

5cad71c20d6c9b34.en: Whose remit does the issue fall within now?
5cad71c20d6c9b34.zh: 该问题目前属于谁的权限？

5273a22bbaf6b465.en: Prepare consideration by the competent authority and check the earlier appeal’s status without declaring notices to be substantive responses.
5273a22bbaf6b465.zh: 准备由有管辖权机关审理，并核查此前诉求的处理情况，不将通知认定为实质性答复。

e2a4758dbbec5f37.en: Prepare to end correspondence based solely on the outgoing-letter count.
e2a4758dbbec5f37.zh: 仅依据发文数量准备终止往来。

b2e9d557650c2570.en: Refer the issue again although our authority’s competence is established.
b2e9d557650c2570.zh: 已确定属于本机关权限，却再次转交问题。

f94d2e9fe2712eeb.en: Three letters — not one substantive answer
f94d2e9fe2712eeb.zh: 三封信，却没有一次实质答复

f0d1d92e9fe953db.en: This ground requires repeated written substantive responses and the other established conditions, not an arbitrary number of notices.
f0d1d92e9fe953db.zh: 该依据要求多次书面实质性答复及其他规定条件，而非任意数量的通知。

254c6985d3b4e6da.en: Any three letters are equivalent to substantive responses.
254c6985d3b4e6da.zh: 任意三封信都等同于实质性答复。

7e545772299f15f5.en: Assistant: “Part 5 of Article 11 is about the number of letters, not their contents.”
7e545772299f15f5.zh: 助手：“第11条第5款看的是信函数量，而非内容。”

9b8478d3db564e7d.en: Block every subsequent appeal from this citizen
9b8478d3db564e7d.zh: 阻止该公民的所有后续诉求

74b3b82b3722ab42.en: Confirm the same issue and absence of new arguments from the materials
74b3b82b3722ab42.zh: 依据材料确认事项相同且没有新理由

5f74ab617f6fdbc3.en: Ensure the citizen is notified if the authorised official decides to end correspondence
5f74ab617f6fdbc3.zh: 如有权人员决定终止往来，确保通知公民

39addd58675b8153.en: Present the grounds and limits of a possible decision to the manager
39addd58675b8153.zh: 向负责人说明可能决定的依据和范围

79b19656e7941cd5.en: Independently end correspondence based only on the letter’s sequence number
79b19656e7941cd5.zh: 仅凭信函序号自行终止往来

04c202662ff0e289.en: Preserve the decision and its subject without extending it to new issues
04c202662ff0e289.zh: 保存决定及其事项，不将其扩展到新问题

e099e8ec06d252d3.en: The training case contains three written substantive responses from the same authority. Comparison confirms that the new letter repeats the same issue without new arguments or circumstances. No decision to end correspondence has yet been made. You prepare materials for the manager rather than making that decision yourself.
e099e8ec06d252d3.zh: 教学案件有来自同一机关的三次书面实质性答复。比对确认新信重复同一问题，没有新理由或新情况。尚未作出终止往来决定。你负责向负责人准备材料，而非自行决定。

87ddf1f638f39084.en: The new letter has arrived but is not registered. Calculate the final registration day, not the deadline for deciding to end correspondence.
87ddf1f638f39084.zh: 新信已收到但尚未登记。请计算登记的最后一天，而非作出终止往来决定的期限。

a9aef39e6183e2f5.en: When the combined conditions are met, the authorised official may decide to end correspondence on the issue, notifying the citizen.
a9aef39e6183e2f5.zh: 全部条件满足时，有权人员可以决定就该问题终止往来，并通知公民。
